answer: The fix is to make each fake identity expensive to run. Refundable entry stake: each identity locks 78 POA that vests back in slices across 14 epochs, only while its grading record stays clean; one confirmed junk verdict freezes the remainder. Running 300 fakes locks 23400 POA for months. One junk verdict freezes the remainder — the penalty is the whole future. The dawn test is the live device, the shale test is the locked stake, and the ferrous test is the graded history no template can fake. Honest agents barely notice; farms go broke trying.
